reason: Verified finding against src/config.ts: readRelayDirective previously iterated backwards across all text blocks in messages[0], allowing injected context or file text blocks to specify @relay directives if the prompt text block lacked one.

Updated readRelayDirective in src/config.ts to locate the prompt text block (the last text block in messages[0] that does not start with <system-reminder>) and parse/strip @relay strictly from that block.
Updated pickSpecs in src/config.ts so namespaced specs with unknown provider prefixes consistently fall back to routing.default instead of bleeding into tier detection.
Updated test/config.test.ts to verify strict prompt text block directive parsing and fallback for unknown provider namespace models with tier substrings.
Verified with `npm run check`: passed 555 tests with 0 type errors.
Verified with `npx vitest run test/config.test.ts`: passed 68 tests.
